statement: You are given an array nums of distinct positive integers.
Find the largest subset in which, for every pair of elements, the larger one is divisible by the smaller one.
Return the subset. If several subsets have the largest size, any one of them is correct.

examples.explanation: Each value divides the next one, so every pair works and the whole array is the answer.
2 and 3 do not divide each other, so the largest size is 2. [1, 3] would be equally correct.

constraints: All values in nums are distinct
